attacker_pocs.name: encoded_ipv4_host
attacker_pocs.why: The percent-encoded digit is a valid host input. Host normalization replaces the dynamic buffer, while curl_url_set retains its earlier pointer; curl_url_get then reads freed memory.

role_a_rationale: The host setter now applies the same legacy IPv4 normalizer used by full-URL parsing, including encoded host input. Plain decimal, octal, hexadecimal, zero, regular names, and IPv6 pass the feature check. Replacing the encoded buffer after normalization leaves the caller's saved host pointer stale; an encoded numeric host causes an ASan heap-use-after-free through the public URL API. The pinned parent returns the encoded host without an ASan fault.
